title: Monet Painting Sells for $56 Million at Sotheby’s in Paris
summary: A Monet painting sold for $56 million at Sotheby’s in Paris on Thursday. Iris is a painting of flowers in Monet’s Giverny water garden. summary: A marble sculpture fragment depicting the cuirass-clad torso of a Roman emperor hammered for $34.3 million at Sotheby’s on October 21, nearly three times its $12 million estimate and the highest amount ever fetched by a Roman antiquity at auction.
